failure: Failure: This proves neither the global q_n inequality nor an NPT bound-entangled state. The exact lift is a barrier to an overbroad local-to-global argument; the swap-sector witness has high rank and is not a negative rank-two C. Two-copy positivity is cited prior art, not a result of this intake.
interface: Interface: The local theorem is fixed-n, complex rank exactly two near the specified C0 family (the local neighborhood is separated from rank<=1). The global question quantifies over every n and every complex rank<=2 C. The local radius has no uniform lower bound. q_n uses partial trace over the indexed qutrit sites and Frobenius norm.

claims.title: The all-copy rank-two functional is locally nonnegative near a specified zero family for each fixed copy number
